info.name: SoleLink Backend - Full Test Run
info.description: Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Needs the backend on http://localhost:8080. Every run creates fresh users (unique emails), so it can be repeated without resetting the database.

exec: pm.test("Message mentions: already registered", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("already registered"); });
pm.test("Message mentions: at least 8", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("at least 8"); });
pm.test("Message mentions: do not match", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("do not match"); });
pm.test("Message mentions: Incorrect email or password", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("Incorrect email or password"); });

pm.test("Buyer details, no token field", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("buyer"); pm.expect(j.user.fullName).to.eql("Aline Uwase"); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.undefined; });

pm.test("Owned by the logged-in vendor, 3 stock rows", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.vendor.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("vendor1Id")); pm.expect(j.stocks.length).to.eql(3); });
pm.test("Message mentions: Price must be greater than 0", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("Price must be greater than 0"); });

pm.test("Has Stride Runner, not City Loafer", function () { var ids = pm.response.json().map(function (s) { return s.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("shoeId")); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("shoe2Id")); });

pm.test("Has City Loafer, not Stride Runner", function () { var ids = pm.response.json().map(function (s) { return s.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("shoe2Id")); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("shoeId")); });
pm.test("Finds City Loafer", function () { var ids = pm.response.json().map(function (s) { return s.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("shoe2Id")); });
pm.test("Prices are descending", function () { var p = pm.response.json().map(function (s) { return s.price; }); for (var i = 1; i < p.length; i++) { pm.expect(p[i - 1]).to.be.at.least(p[i]); } });
pm.test("Message mentions: do not own", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("do not own"); });
pm.test("Size 41 now has 4", function () { var s = pm.response.json().stocks.find(function (x) { return x.size === 41; }); pm.expect(s.quantity).to.eql(4); });
pm.test("One item, quantity 2", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].quantity).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Message mentions: available stock", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("available stock"); });

pm.test("Pending, numbered, total = subtotal + 2500", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(j.orderNumber).to.match(/^SL-\d{4}-\d{4}$/); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(j.subtotal + 2500); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].shoeName).to.eql("Stride Runner"); });
pm.test("Size 40 has 2", function () { var s = pm.response.json().stocks.find(function (x) { return x.size === 40; }); pm.expect(s.quantity).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Message mentions: bag is empty", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("bag is empty"); });
pm.test("Order listed", function () { var n = pm.response.json().map(function (o) { return o.orderNumber; }); pm.expect(n).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderNumber")); });
pm.test("Order listed", function () { var n = pm.response.json().map(function (o) { return o.orderNumber; }); pm.expect(n).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderNumber")); });
pm.test("Message mentions: reason is required", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("reason is required"); });
